Kitchen & Dining.seasonality_notes: Mild festive uplift around Diwali gifting season; otherwise steady year-round demand.
Kitchen & Dining.brand_potential_notes: Moderate — repeat purchase is common for consumable/replaceable items (storage, cookware sets), but standalone items commoditize quickly.

Compare against steel/glass alternatives for real differentiation
Verify capacity/dimension claims match the product photos

Apparel & Fashion.brand_potential_notes: High — one of the strongest repeat-purchase and brand-loyalty categories when fit and quality are consistent.
